episodes.name: Survival of the Fittest
episodes.overviewEn: While being pursued by the Enforcers, Spider-Man has to protect Norman Osborn from the vengeful supervillain Vulture.

episodes.name: Interactions
episodes.overviewEn: When a lab accident transforms Max Dillon into supervillain Electro, he demands that Dr. Martha Connors find a cure as Spider-Man works to stop him.

episodes.name: Natural Selection
episodes.overviewEn: When. Dr. Curt Connors' attempt to regenerate a new arm accidentally transforms him into the Lizard, Peter, Martha, Eddie and Gwen search for a cure.

episodes.name: Market Forces
episodes.overviewEn: Following orders from Tombstone, Hammerhead hires Montana to steal a high-tech suit and, as the Shocker, destroy Spider-Man.

episodes.name: Competition
episodes.overviewEn: As Peter Parker and Harry Osborn try out for the football team, Spider-Man must face convict Flint Marko, newly transformed into the Sandman in order to destroy Spider-Man.

episodes.name: The Invisible Hand
episodes.overviewEn: As Otto creates the Rhino as a new distraction for Spider-Man, Peter takes Aunt May's advice and asks Mary Jane Watson to the high school prom.

episodes.name: Catalysts
episodes.overviewEn: Peter and Mary Jane are a hit at the Fall Formal. Meanwhile, the Green Goblin's attack on Lincoln's dinner party requires Spider-Man's intervention.

episodes.name: Reaction
episodes.overviewEn: When the Green Goblin fuses Otto's robotic arms to his body, the newly created Doctor Octopus must find a new power source as Spider-Man pursues him.

episodes.name: The Uncertainty Principle
episodes.overviewEn: Spider-Man faces off against the Green Goblin and Tombstone. Elsewhere, Col. John Jameson attempts to land a damaged space shuttle.

episodes.name: Persona
episodes.overviewEn: Disguised as Spider-Man, the Chameleon embarks on a crime spree that can only be stopped by Spidey and the Black Cat -- together.

episodes.name: Group Therapy
episodes.overviewEn: When the Sinister Six escape from prison with plans to take down Spider-Man, they nearly succeed. But Peter wakes up with no memory of the battle.

episodes.name: Intervention
episodes.overviewEn: As he struggles with the alien symbiote, Spider-Man's origins are revealed.

episodes.name: Nature vs. Nurture
episodes.overviewEn: Venom -- the merged entity consisting of Eddie Brock and the symbiote -- attacks Spider-Man through the people he loves most.

episodes.name: Blueprints
episodes.overviewEn: Peter's "to do" list includes talking to Gwen Stacy about their first kiss. But before he gets a chance, Spider-Man has a run-in with Mysterio.

episodes.name: Destructive Testing
episodes.overviewEn: Both Liz Allan and Gwen like Peter. Whom should he pursue? Meanwhile, Kraven the Hunter has come to New York City to make Spider-Man his prey.

episodes.name: Reinforcement
episodes.overviewEn: As Christmas approaches, the Sinister Six reconstitutes with Sandman, Rhino, Vulture, Electro and new members Mysterio and Kraven.

episodes.name: Shear Strength
episodes.overviewEn: With the Master Planner and his henchmen planning to take over the world, a highly motivated Spider-Man takes the fight to the Planner's secret lair.

episodes.name: First Steps
episodes.overviewEn: Amazingly, Peter is invited to Flash Thompson's birthday bash. Meanwhile, Spider-Man has to party with Sandman, who's looking to make his big score.

episodes.name: Growing Pains
episodes.overviewEn: After alien spores infect John Jameson -- increasing his size, strength and mass -- his dad persuades him to become a superhero to capture Spider-Man.

episodes.name: Identity Crisis
episodes.overviewEn: Peter and his loved ones become vulnerable to all of Spider-Man's enemies when Venom exposes Peter's secret identity.

episodes.name: Accomplices
episodes.overviewEn: A gang war looms as Silver Sable, Hammerhead and Doctor Octopus vie for a prize that could change the balance of power in New York City's underworld.

episodes.name: Probable Cause
episodes.overviewEn: Some days, Peter just can't win -- especially when he ends up on a Midtown High police car ride... and as Spider-Man, he isn't faring any better.

episodes.name: Gangland
episodes.overviewEn: On Valentine's Day, Tombstone, Doctor Octopus and Silvermane call a summit that erupts into a gang war -- one that only Spider-Man can stop.

episodes.name: Subtext
episodes.overviewEn: When the Green Goblin blackmails Liz's brother Mark into doing his bidding, neither Liz, Mary Jane nor Spider-Man may be able to save him.

episodes.name: Opening Night
episodes.overviewEn: To test a new Ryker's security cell, Spider-Man volunteers to try to escape. But the Green Goblin traps him inside amid a sea of felons he put away.

episodes.name: Final Curtain
episodes.overviewEn: When Peter breaks up with Liz to be with Gwen, nothing goes as planned. Likewise for Spider-Man, who finally unmasks the Green Goblin.
